Name: Farmhouse Wood Storage
Author: JulianIZ
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]Wood storage allows you to use the pile of logs in the farmhouse sprite stacked by the front door. [/color]

[color=#ffffff][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51483/51483-1788111480-2029666090.gif[/img][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color][color=#ffffff]
Just walk over to the wood pile and open it like you would a normal chest. Wood pile will only accept normal wood and hardwood.

Storage gets larger as you upgrade the house[/color]
[color=#ffffff]Base Level - 1 storage slot[/color]

[color=#ffffff][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51483/51483-1788119076-417818375.png[/img][/color]
[color=#ffffff]Upgraded House - 3 Storage Slots[/color]

[color=#ffffff][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51483/51483-1788119077-952352950.png[/img][/color]
[color=#ffffff]Final House Upgrade - 9 Storage Slots:[/color]

[color=#ffffff][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51483/51483-1788119081-1818806311.png[/img][/color]
[color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Download the latest release of Wood Storage.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Extract the WoodStorage folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later[/color][/*]
[/list][heading][color=#ffffff][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/heading]
[color=#ffffff]Mod should work regardless of what mods are installed. Open an issue if it doesn't work with a mod that I am overlooking.[/color]

[heading][color=#ffffff][size=4]AI Usage[/size][/color][/heading]
[color=#ffffff]AI was used in development of this mod.[/color]
